text:
kevin: Hey people-ops, question: Our SRE on-call lead was supposed to take 16h PTO during the companybridge week, but team is short staff. Manager wants to approve 8h now and keep 8h as conditional carryover to be used after the blackout. Is that allowed?

marta: Short answer: we can do conditional carryover as an exception but need to document use-by date + manager sign-off. Also check payroll cutoff if you want the balance showing on the next pay period.

ryan: From ops side, curious if we can implement a "split booking" in the HR system so 8h is available now and 8h is a reserved balance flagged with a use-by date. That makes approvals clear.

olivia: People Ops: we don't have a native "reserved balance" field but we can record an exception note on the employee record and add a tracking tag. The payroll system needs an explicit action if you want balances altered across pay periods.

kevin: Manager suggests we put the 8h carryover into a "conditional bucket" that expires in 6 months. Would that be fine? Also manager will sign off that the carryover is allowed only for non-blackout weeks.

marta: Fine with 6 months. Required steps: 1) manager fills short exception form (link: /forms/hr/carryover-exception), 2) People Ops approves and adds use-by date, 3) Payroll ingests CSV to adjust balance on effective date, 4) legal signs off if cross-border.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Note - payroll cutoff for this cycle is 2026-04-02 17:00 PT. Any balance changes after cutoff apply to next pay period. For conditional buckets, payroll needs a CSV with action=reserve and expiry_date. Sample below.

ryan: Can you paste the CSV shape?

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: CSV example for reserve/carryover:```
employee_id,action,hours,effective_date,expiry_date,pay_code,notes
45512,reserve,8,2026-04-05,2026-10-05,RESV,conditional carryover approved by manager
45512,add,8,2026-04-05,2026-10-05,CARR,approved exception shown as carried balance
```

olivia: Legal: any flags if the employee is in EU/UK?

legal: legal: Yes - in some EU jurisdictions, accrued leave cannot be unilaterally restricted or conditioned in a way that impairs use. If the employee is UK/EU-based we need to confirm that a conditional expiry is enforceable. Please include country in the form and we'll review.

kevin: Good catch. Employee is US-based, so conditional expiry is OK. Manager will fill the form and attach a short coverage plan.

marta: Also note: since this is a critical role, consider whether the leftover 8h should require a separate manager approval each time it's used. Manager's original ask was to require sign-off to prevent misuse. If you want that, add "manager_approval_required" field in the form.

kevin: Yes please add that requirement.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Final checklist before payroll runs: 1) completed form submitted, 2) People Ops approval recorded, 3) CSV uploaded to payroll SFTP with filename: carryover_45512_20260405.csv, 4) GL account for carryover entries (Finance to confirm).

ryan: Thanks. I'll draft the coverage plan and manager will sign off now.

marta: Once submitted, tag @people-ops so we pick it up. We'll route to Finance and Legal if needed.

kevin: Done - submitted the form and attached coverage plan. Pinged @marta.

marta: Received. People Ops will review within 48h and ping payroll for CSV ingestion. :white_check_mark:

legal: legal: If any part of this becomes a recurring policy (e.g., conditional buckets for critical roles), loop Legal early so we can draft standard language and consistent expiry rules.

kevin: Great, thanks all. Will keep the thread updated if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
